name: Kuro Gyaru Inmai Anna-chan ~Jimi na Imouto ga Henbou Shite Onii-chan Zenryoku Dokusen!~
original_name: 黒ギャル淫妹 杏奈ちゃん ～地味な妹が変貌してお兄ちゃん全力独占！～
source:
As a tennis scholarship student and captain of the tennis club, our protagonist is dedicated to his studies and club activities at a boarding school and he is highly respected at school.
However, his true nature is that of a pervert who loves dark-skinned girls and collects images and videos of them on his computer and smartphone.
Though he hides his true nature, Anna can't help but notice.

One day, he learns that his younger sister will be attending the same school as the protagonist on a tennis recommendation, and he is genuinely happy.
Then, after the entrance ceremony, while the protagonist is out recruiting, a dark-skinned gal, the protagonist's type, visits the tennis club booth.

"Hey! Is this the tennis club? I'm here to join!"

Unable to contain his excitement, the protagonist panics as he tries to respond.

"Can you take me to the coach's place, brother?"

The dark-skinned girl turns out to be his younger sister, Anna, who has completely transformed from her plain appearance...

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1054077]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
作为一名网球奖学金生和网球俱乐部队长，我们的主角在寄宿学校致力于学习和俱乐部活动，在学校备受尊重。
然而，他的真实本性是一个喜欢黑皮肤女孩并在电脑和智能手机上收集她们的图像和视频的变态。
尽管他隐藏了自己的真实本性，安娜还是忍不住注意到了。

有一天，他得知妹妹通过网球推荐将与主角就读同一所学校，他由衷地高兴。
然后，入学仪式结束后，当主角外出招募时，一位与主角类型相同的黑皮肤女孩参观了网球俱乐部的摊位。

“喂！这里是网球社吗？我来参加！”

主角无法抑制自己的兴奋，在试图回应时感到惊慌。

“哥哥，你能带我去教练那里吗？”

那个皮肤黝黑的女孩，原来是他的妹妹安娜，一改素颜的模样……
